map.same padding(使 out=in/stride)保护边缘信息、控制尺寸: same padding (making out=in/stride) protects edge information and controls the size, while valid (no padding) shrinks the feature map step by step. Edge pixels are covered by the convolution fewer times, so padding mitigates the loss of edge information.
map.→ 打开图像卷积输出尺寸工具: -> Open the Image Convolution Output Size tool
map.卷积输出尺寸由输入宽、卷积核、填充、步长与膨胀率共同决定，结果须为整数，非整除时: The convolution output size is jointly determined by the input width, kernel, padding, stride and dilation rate; the result must be an integer, and when it does not divide evenly most frameworks round down (discarding the edge). Dilated convolution enlarges the receptive field by (K−1)(D−1) without adding parameters, which suits dense prediction tasks.
map.池化层用相同公式；空洞卷积需把 kernel 替换为 dilation×(k−1: The pooling layer uses the same formula; for a dilated convolution replace the kernel with dilation×(k−1)+1.
map.设计 CNN 时需逐层推算特征图尺寸，确保首尾维度匹配、不出现负数。: When designing a CNN you must derive the feature map size layer by layer to make sure the first and last dimensions match and no negative value appears.
map.说明参数组合非法(如 stride 过大、kernel 超过输入)。需调小 st: It means the parameter combination is invalid (for example the stride is too large or the kernel exceeds the input). Reduce the stride, increase the padding or shrink the kernel until the formula result is ≥1.
map.输入输入尺寸、卷积核、步长与填充，计算卷积或池化后的特征图尺寸，适用于 CNN: Enter the input size, kernel, stride and padding to compute the feature map size after convolution or pooling, for CNN architecture design, dimension checking and deployment adaptation.
map.输出出现小数或负数说明什么？: What Does a Fractional or Negative Output Mean?
map.输出尺寸 = ⌊(W + 2P − K − (K − 1)(D − 1))/S⌋: Output size = ⌊(W + 2P − K − (K − 1)(D − 1))/S⌋ + 1; receptive field = K + (K − 1)(D − 1)
map.：输入 224×224，kernel=3, stride=1, padding=: : with input 224×224, kernel=3, stride=1, padding=1 → out=224. If stride=2 → out=⌊(224+2−3)/2⌋+1=112, so the feature map is halved while the channel count is unchanged.
